name: codemode
description: Write and use the `eval` tool well: batch tool calls in JavaScript, keep large intermediate data inside the script, and return one compact result.
whenToUse: Before writing an eval call that makes more than a couple of tool calls, loops over tool calls, or filters/aggregates results — load this to get the return semantics, the tools.* API, and the failure shapes right the first time.
